name: anyreality-resi-stack
description: GPL-3.0 self-hosted multi-path sing-box edge gateway & WAN transport resilience stack (residential & data-center split-egress routing) for authorized Ubuntu 22.04+ and Debian 12+ servers, combining VLESS+REALITY+Vision (TCP), Hysteria2 (UDP), optional CDN-fronted VLESS+WebSocket relay, selective Cloudflare WARP WireGuard egress (--with-warp), tri-format adaptive subscriptions (sing-box JSON, Clash/mihomo YAML, Base64 URIs), and dual-node domain routing.
applicationSubCategory: Self-hosted sing-box edge gateway deployment stack and subscription server
featureList: Idempotent Bash installer for Ubuntu 22.04+ and Debian 12+ with --dry-run and --config
Three-path transport raced by client url-test: VLESS+REALITY+Vision (TCP), Hysteria2 (UDP with pinned self-signed cert), and optional CDN-fronted VLESS+WebSocket relay
Origin-side WebSocket application ping injector preventing ~100s CDN idle disconnects
Alternate ports (2096/8880/40443) via dual-stack iptables/ip6tables NAT REDIRECT
Inline client rule-sets eliminating cold-start remote rule_set FATAL boot deadlocks

Three-ecosystem adaptive subscription server (Python stdlib only): sing-box JSON, Clash/mihomo YAML, and Base64 URI bundle via User-Agent or ?format=singbox|clash|uris with gzip and Subscription-Userinfo
Server-side selective Cloudflare WARP WireGuard egress (--with-warp) with 10-stage C9 route invariants and 2-minute auto-degrade/recover watchdog
Dual-node residential + data-center smart routing (OpenAI/Anthropic/Netflix/banking vs Telegram/Discord)
GPG-pinned Sagernet apt installation, UFW with Cloudflare origin CIDR fallback, fail2ban, BBR + UDP/QUIC buffer tuning, and CI secret/redact gate
softwareRequirements: sing-box (installed from official Sagernet apt repository)
